title: Nile CL (Linea) — Ramses V2 CL fork: no unprivileged extraction; LP principal + vote fees are owner/share-gated
closed_reasons: pool principal: NFP manager gates decreaseLiquidity/collect/burn with _isApprovedOrOwner; pool-level collect keys positions by msg.sender only; pool positions are custodied by the NFP manager (or by gated vaults/lockers)

non-NFT holders: NileHypervisor vaults (deposit whitelisted; pullLiquidity/rebalance/compound onlyOwner; withdraw burns own shares), TeaVaultV3Pair (liquidity/swap onlyManager; callbacks require msg.sender==pool; multicall delegatecall preserves msg.sender), FreeUniV3LPLocker (collect/unlock require lock owner or collector)
protocol fees: ClPool.collectProtocol onlyFeeCollector; FeeCollector.collectProtocolFees (permissionless) pays treasury (BribeHolder, treasuryFees=100%) / feeDistributor only, never the caller
gauge rewards: GaugeV2.getReward/ForOwner require NFP owner/approved or voter; retrieveLeftovers pays treasury and reverts for period > 2830 (all live periods)

fee distributor rewards: claims require veNFT isApprovedOrOwner; per-(period,tokenId) userClaimed caps claims; deposit/withdraw keep sum(userVotes)<=votes; the deployed variant is NOT the Oct-2024 Ramses vulnerable accumulator

admin/fees/implementation: owner=Timelock (24h, PROPOSER/EXECUTOR=Gnosis Safe only), feeSetter=CommandCenter (AccessControl roles), proxy admin owner=Timelock; no CallScheduled events in last 1M blocks
price init: all 391 pools initialized; pool.initialize reverts AI; factory.initializePool no-ops
NPM/factory/voter/feeCollector/gauges hold 0 of all pool tokens and 0 ETH

Independent adversarial boost/period review (analysis/child-boost-review.md): all 5 areas NOT exploitable; 2 share-only boost bookkeeping bugs found (unchecked timesAttached-1 underflow Position.sol:757-766; veNftAmount drift :791-792 vs :761-766), moot for live periods > 2830 (base seconds only)
GaugeV2.retrieveLeftovers sends leftover boosted rewards to feeCollector.treasury() only and reverts Nope for period>2830; normal NFP-owner claims still work

NPM.sweepToken/unwrapWETH9/refundETH are permissionless (upstream design) but NPM holds $0 today (latent only); PositionManagerAux external library directly callable but reverts (library-own empty storage, owns no positions)
caveats: First heavy scan enumerated ids 1..totalSupply and undercounted (29 positions); the id space is 5–202,828 because ~195k ids were minted and burned. Fixed by enumerating via tokenByIndex; final CI run 38435970075 (success) carries the corrected 4,258-position scan. Test suite 15/15 in both runs.
No byte-exact upstream diff for this V2 build (sibling deployment on Fraxtal is a different, older build). Analysis is on explorer-verified source matching deployed bytecode.
Pool-math/boost code was reviewed manually and by an independent subagent; a novel arithmetic bug cannot be excluded with 100% certainty (would pay out of the $145k LP principal).
NILE priced via GeckoTerminal ($0.0039547); xNILE and most memecoins unpriced (treated as $0, amounts recorded).
NPM sweepToken latent path only matters if tokens ever rest in the NPM (collect(recipient=0)); $0 exposure measured today.
All values are reads at the recorded blocks; no transactions were sent.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 from Nile CL (Linea, $145k pools): every valued token is behind NFP/veNFT ownership, vault-share or lock-owner gates, or timelock/role-gated admin; the permissionless FeeCollector/gauge leftover paths only pay the protocol treasury, and the deployed reward accounting is the non-vulnerable Ramses variant.
